status.title: Modded Server Downtime Till Launch
status.message: The modded server will be down until the full launch on Saturday, August 2nd. Please check back then!

status.title: CrashCraft Network Core
status.message: The CrashCraft Network's revival plans have been put on hold to prioritize the modded server launch. The core network will be back online once the modded server is stable.
